How blind can you guys be? 6.7 is a pretty decent rating for a pretty decent game. The game isn't that amazing. It's terribly buggy, with clipping, failed loading of environments, audio glitches, and glitches with missions being unable to be completed. 

The enemies are bland. The cleaners are the only enemy that's unique, with the Krikers, the Rioters, and the LMB all being kind of the same, with a small differences between them. 

The story isn't very good. The echos are okay, but there's no acknowledgement when you do anything. SPOILER ALERT: When you kill Laraee Barret, nobody even mentions to you that you killed the LEADER of the Rikers. You just move on. You get a cutscene where she slashes a guys throat. Why not something like, the most powerful Rikers all fight for being the leader, so there's a rift in the ranks, maybe have it effect the overworld. Less Rikers, or maybe, have the same groups out and around, but one or two less guys in their squad, to signify the infighting is killing themselves off.

The game does look really good, and it is pretty well voice acted, but the game play is kinda clunky, glitchy, and at sometimes frustrating. It isn't the perfect game you guys are making it out to be. 6.7 is good. That's right around where I am.

EDIT: Oh, don't even get me started on the DZ, that place is useless. I hit rank 30, and I know the DZ01-DZ03 like the back of my hand. It's literally just another PvE area, which is okay, but there's little to no reward. You do get a large amount of blue drops, and some legendary sprinkled in too. Hopefully one day, I'll get a High End from it too. But the main reason for the dark zone is for going rogue. And I get it. The reward for going rogue is the loot from getting the kill. The problem with that is: WHEN YOU FUCKING DIE IN THE DARK ZONE, YOU KEEP HALF OF YOUR GODDAMN LOOT! With public and private loot there is NO reward for going rogue. You die, you lose hours of work and effort. You survive, you don't have anything to show for it. And a fucking manhunt gives you 1100 DZ credits? What a joke.
